SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Terry Kistler, Chair
Scott Snider, Vice Chair  Jenny Jolly, Committee Member
George Borst, Committee Member  Mary Smith, Committee Member
Edward Padgett, Committee Member  Bette Donovan Committee Member

  Wednesday, June 17, 2026
  Regular Meeting at 10:00 AM
  La Verne Community Center
  3680 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City
Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Persons addressing the Senior Advisory Committee shall be limited to 3 minutes unless an extension
of time is granted by the Chair, subject to approval of the Committee Members. When any group of
persons wishes to address the Committee, it shall be proper for the Chair to request that a
spokesperson be chosen to represent the group.

Public comments will be allowed on items on this Agenda at the time each item is considered.

Mission of the Senior Advisory Committee
To plan for coordinated delivery of services to senior citizens to eliminate duplication and conflict of
effort, as well as to inform its seniors of the availability of programs.

CALL TO ORDER AND PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENTATIONS

1.  Hayley Flores, Elderly Nutrition Program Regional Coordinator, YWCA San Gabriel
  Valley

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

2.  Wednesday, May 20, 2026

DISCUSSION ITEMS

3.
  a.  Senior Nutrition Program
  b.  Meals on Wheels Update
 AGENDA  Senior Citizen Advisory Committee 6/17/2026  Page 2

  c.  Bingo Report
  d.  Account Balance Update
  e.  Monthly Program Fees
  f.  Mt. SAC Classes Update
  g.  AgingNext
  h.  Facilities Report
  i.  Upcoming Events

PUBLIC COMMENT
Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction
of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda items except as provided by law.

STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION & INFORMATION
Committee members may ask a question for clarification, make a brief announcement, make a brief
report on his/her own activities, request staff to report back at a subsequent meeting concerning any
matter, or take action to direct staff to place a matter of business on a future agenda.

ADJOURNMENT

The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 AM on August 19, 2026 at the La Verne Community Center.

Posting Statement: A true copy of this Agenda was posted on Wednesday, June 10, 2026,
on the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website
at www.laverneca.gov

MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, June 17, 2026

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, June 17, 2026.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, Jenny Jolly, Edward Padgett, Mary Smith, George
  Borst.

  Members Absent: Bette Donovan, Scott Snider.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist.

  It was moved by Edward Padgett and seconded by George Borst to approve the
  minutes of Wednesday, May 20, 2026 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Hayley Flores, Elderly Nutrition Program Regional Coordinator,
  YWCA San Gabriel Valley spoke to the committee about the large footprint they
  have from Montebello to Claremont. They host 12 events yearly for the
  community. From December 2025 to the present, they have served over 6,166
  meals for the La Verne Community Center Seniors.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 521 meals were served to an average of 27 participants in May.
  Meals have been lowered to 27 meals per day due to budget constraints with the
  YWCA.

  Meals on Wheels: Total number of La Verne residents served for the month of
  April 2026 was 492. Total number of La Verne residents served for the month
  of May 2026 was 461.

4. Bingo Report: Receipts for May 2026 totaled $9,610.00 (rent to City of La
  Verne $315.00; supplies expense to Bingo West $863.00; Miscellaneous
  $85.00; Payouts $8,300.00). Attendance over 4 dates was 315 participants.

5. Account Balance: $9,323.38.

6. Senior Program Fees: All program fees are paid.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: The spring session is going well. Spring session will end on
  June, 12, 2026. Summer session will begin on Monday, June 22, 2026.

8. Aging Next: Total number of La Verne residents served for the month of April
  was 3.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: No update.

10. Upcoming Events

  •  Thursday, June 25th– Excursion: Palm Spring Aerial Tramway, 9:30AM – 6:00PM.
  •  Sunday, June 28th – Concerts in the Park: Pat Benatar Tribute, 6:30PM.
  •  Saturday, July 4th – Fourth of July Parade: 10:00AM; Fireworks: Gates Open at 6:00PM for 7:00PM
  show.
  •  Tuesday, July 7th – Excursion: The Broad and Grand Central Market, 9:30AM – 4:00PM.
  •  Sunday, July 12th– Concerts in the Park: Cold Duck (Dance Band), 6:30PM.
  •  Monday, July 13th – Movie Matinee: My Best Friend’s Wedding, 12:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, July 22nd – Senior Seminar, Depression and Anxiety, Presented by Los Angeles County
  Department of Mental Health, 10:00AM.
  •  Friday, July 24th – Excursion: Big Bear Lake Escape, 8:30AM – 6:00PM.
  •  Sunday, July 26th – Concerts in the Park: Silverado’s (Eagles Tribute Band), 6:30PM.
  •  Sunday, August 2nd – Excursion: A Day at the Ballpark: Angels vs Brewers, 10:00AM – 5:30PM.
  •  Tuesday, August 4th – National Night Out, 4:30PM – 7:30PM.
  •  Sunday, August 9th – Concerts in the Park: The Answer (Classic Rock), 6:30PM.
  •  Monday, August 10th – Movie Matinee: Meet the Fockers, 12:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, August 26th– Senior Seminar, Late Life Transitions, Presented by Los Angeles County
  Department of Mental Health, 10:30AM.

  Public Comments: Armando shared that he and Robyn have begun working on
  bylaws for the Senior Advisory Committee. A draft should be available for the
  August meeting.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:40AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, August 19, 2026 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
